finding: At the pinned commit, TransactionAbortStrategyImpl defines synchronous PROBING and LISTING implementations behind the abstract abortTransactions(Context) entry point. PROBING loops over prefixes/subtasks/checkpoint ids and calls the injected TransactionAborter; LISTING obtains open transactions from Context and calls the injected aborter for selected ids. The class contains no timer, thread, scheduler, callback registration, background loop, or other independent trigger that invokes abortTransactions. Within this class, cleanup executes only when an external caller invokes abortTransactions with a Context.
